probe: P1+P2 latent-state decodability & nuisance non-retention (WM_PHYSICS_PROOF.md P1/P2)
tier: T0-diagnostic (representation probe — NEVER a driving-performance number; one row of the WM-physics battery, not a standalone driving eval; no ADE / four-family table is produced here by design)

preregistration.p1: per driving target: R2(z_hat, k=10) >= 0.85 x R2(z_enc, k=10); AND R2(z_hat) drop between consecutive evaluated horizons (k grid (5, 10, 15, 20)) < 0.25 (operationalisation of 'error grows smoothly, no cliff')
preregistration.p2: episode-ID OOF accuracy from z_hat at k=20 is BELOW its k=5 value AND < 0.5 x its k=5 value; chance = 1/n_episodes reported alongside; acc(k=5) <= 1.1 x chance passes trivially (branch 'at_chance_from_start')
preregistration.note: gates committed in code before any number was produced; the P2 operationalisation above IS the pre-registration of the doc's 'drops with k'

gate.rule: per driving target: R2(z_hat, k=10) >= 0.85 x R2(z_enc, k=10); AND R2(z_hat) drop between consecutive evaluated horizons (k grid (5, 10, 15, 20)) < 0.25 (operationalisation of 'error grows smoothly, no cliff')

lead_gap.reason: R2(enc) <= 0 at the gate horizon — the encoded-latent probe itself failed; retention is undefined (fix the probe/target before gating the predictor)

episode_identity.probe: multinomial logistic (linear softmax, zero-init, full-batch, deterministic)

fold_scheme.scheme: within-episode temporal blocks (5 contiguous runs per episode, block j -> fold j; consistent across k)
fold_scheme.reason: episode-disjoint folds are DEGENERATE for the episode-identity target: a held-out episode is an unseen class, accuracy is 0 by construction and the decay gate becomes vacuous (0 < 0). All OTHER targets use episode-disjoint folds (the leakage rule).

static_appearance_brightness.probe: ridge (episode-disjoint folds) on mean WINDOW-START frame brightness — a pure appearance scalar (no extra labels needed)
static_appearance_brightness.note: reported, not gated — the P2 gate is on episode identity

weather_illumination.reason: weather/illumination CLASS labels arrive with the VLM labeling pipeline (VLM_STRATEGIC_LABELING.md); n/a today — reported per the discipline rule, not silently dropped

gate.rule: episode-ID OOF accuracy from z_hat at k=20 is BELOW its k=5 value AND < 0.5 x its k=5 value; chance = 1/n_episodes reported alongside; acc(k=5) <= 1.1 x chance passes trivially (branch 'at_chance_from_start')

lead_label_provenance.class_filter: NONE — the join-file schema carries no label_class; build the join with agents_at_time(classes=VEHICLE_CLASSES) pod-side for class purity

folds.scheme_episode_identity: within-episode temporal blocks (documented deviation — see p2.episode_identity.fold_scheme)
